controls.name: consonantDb
controls.doc: How far a hard consonant (t, k) is cut in its band, dB, at full contrast: y = x1 + (g - 1) B, the de-esser's split, so no gain is added at any frequency. 0 cuts nothing, bit for bit.

controls.name: sensitivityDb
controls.doc: The contrast, dB between the band's fast and slow envelopes (omx_envdiff), a burst must pass before the consonant cut starts; the cut is full TRANSIENT_REF_DB past it (omx_envdiff_ramp). A contrast, not a level: the same t is treated the same at any gain.

controls.name: recoveryMs
controls.doc: The consonant detector's slow attack, ms: how long a burst's contrast lasts, so how long the cut does.

controls.name: bandHz
controls.doc: The consonant band's centre, Hz: the de-esser's cookbook bandpass section.

controls.name: bandWidthOct
controls.doc: The consonant band's width, octaves; its top edge is held under PLOSIVE_BAND_EDGE_FRACTION of the rate.

controls.name: popDb
controls.doc: How far a p pop is cut below popHz, dB, at full contrast: x1 = x - (1 - g) LP, the low half of a first-order power-complementary split, so no gain is added. 0 cuts nothing, bit for bit.

controls.name: popSensitivityDb
controls.doc: The contrast, dB, the pop band's burst must pass before the pop cut starts.

controls.name: popRecoveryMs
controls.doc: The pop detector's slow attack, ms.

controls.name: popHz
controls.doc: The pop split's corner, Hz: the first-order allpass (omx_allpass1) whose halves are the pop band and the rest.

readouts.name: consonantReductionDb
readouts.doc: The deepest consonant cut the last block applied, dB with CLAP's sign: 0 while nothing is cut.

readouts.name: popReductionDb
readouts.doc: The deepest pop cut the last block applied, dB with CLAP's sign: 0 while nothing is cut.

PLOSIVE_BAND_EDGE_FRACTION.doc: The consonant band's top edge is held under this share of the rate, the de-esser's rule: the band is redesigned from its held edges, so the clamp is never silent.
